title: MAT Common Page
summary: Official Derivative MAT Common page reference for shader-independent rendering controls: blending, depth test/write, alpha test, wire frame, cull face, and polygon depth offset.
guidance: Use this article when a material needs render-state tuning independent of the shader code itself.
Blending combines source and destination color and is the core render-state control for many transparency workflows.
Depth test controls whether a pixel is accepted relative to the depth buffer; depthwriting controls whether accepted pixels update that depth buffer.
Alpha test discards pixels by alpha threshold before they are drawn.
Use polygon depth offset for overlapping-polygon z-fighting and shadow workflows where biasing depth is required.
